description: Estimates municipal building plan scrutiny fees (ZAR) in Gauteng based on total floor area (sqm), municipality, and SANS 10400 occupancy classification. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'estimate_scrutiny_fee' on Building Compliance Agency (buildingcompliance.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'check_zoning_requirements' or 'submit_compliance_inquiry' for their respective operations). Parameters: floor_area_sqm (required), municipality (required), building_classification (required). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

building_classification.description: SANS 10400 occupancy classification (e.g., H4 for dwelling house, G1 for offices) [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

floor_area_sqm.description: Total floor area in square meters (sqm) [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

municipality.description: Gauteng metropolitan municipality [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

name: estimate_scrutiny_fee
title: Estimate Scrutiny Fee
